description: Move task to different list or workspace. High-integrity move (ID/history preserving) is used by default. Cross-workspace discovery is automatic: server searches all available workspaces for source and destination. Deep migration (Copy-Delete) is used for cross-workspace moves. IF BLOCKED by plan limits for intra-workspace move, you MUST ask the user for permission to use allowDestructiveFallback.

allowDestructiveFallback.description: Set to true ONLY AFTER EXPLICIT USER CONSENT. Allows a Copy-Delete move if TIML is forbidden. Warning: Task ID will change and history will reset.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: move_task
